sources.title: Short shelf source
sources.text: This chunk describes the procedures for using a fictional neighborhood book shelf. Key steps include: checking the book's label and pages for dryness before borrowing, leaving wet or damaged books on a marked tray for the shelf keeper, returning borrowed books through a slot, keeping the slot clear, and the shelf keeper checking returned books before placing them back on the shelf.
